shared.action.back: Standard navigation control that returns to the previous screen.
shared.action.cancel: Cancel the current action without saving it.
shared.action.close: Dismiss a dialog, sheet or notice.
shared.action.continue: Advance to the next step in a flow.
shared.action.retry: Repeat the operation that just failed.
shared.app.name: Product name; keep the brand spelling unchanged.
shared.status.lastConfirmed: Offline or stale status. {time} is the already formatted time of the last successful confirmation.
shared.status.offline: Short connectivity status when the app is offline.
shared.status.pendingChanges: Number of local changes waiting to sync. {count} is a non-negative integer.
